title: ESQL: Fix unreleased block in topn

timeline.message:
ESQL: Fix unreleased block in topn

This fixes a bug in the topn operator where it'll fail to de-track
blocks if there's a failure while building the results from topn.

Closes #101588
timeline.author: Nik Everett
